Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Public Sub AddGizmoNoSee()
    Dim rsNoSee As DAO.Recordset
    Set rsNoSee = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("Gizmos", dbOpenDynaset)
    rsNoSee.AddNew
    rsNoSee!Label = "fixture label"
    rsNoSee.Update
End Sub

Public Sub AddGizmoSee()
    Dim rsSee As DAO.Recordset
    Set rsSee = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("Gizmos", _
        dbOpenDynaset, dbSeeChanges)
    rsSee.AddNew
    rsSee.Update
End Sub

Public Sub AddBinContinued()
    Dim rsCont As DAO.Recordset
    Set rsCont = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM Bins", _
        dbOpenDynaset)
    rsCont.AddNew
    rsCont.Update
End Sub

Public Sub CommentedOut()
    ' Set rsOld = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("Bins", dbOpenDynaset)
    Dim strSQL As String
    strSQL = "DELETE FROM Gizmos " & _
             "WHERE GizmoID = 0"
    CurrentDb.Execute strSQL, dbFailOnError ' dbSeeChanges
    DoCmd.RunSQL "UPDATE Bins SET Code = Code"
End Sub

Public Sub FindBin()
    Dim rsFind As DAO.Recordset
    Set rsFind = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("Bins", dbOpenTable)
    rsFind.Index = "PrimaryKey"
    rsFind.Seek "=", 1
End Sub

Public Sub RelinkBins()
    Dim tdBins As DAO.TableDef
    Set tdBins = CurrentDb.TableDefs("Bins")
    tdBins.Connect = "ODBC;DSN=FixtureSource"
    tdBins.RefreshLink
    lngCount = DCount("*", "MSysObjects")
End Sub

Public Sub TouchEveryTable()
    Dim tdAny As DAO.TableDef
    Dim strDyn As String
    Dim strFmt As String
    For Each tdAny In CurrentDb.TableDefs
        strDyn = "UPDATE " & tdAny.Name & " SET Touched = 1"
        CurrentDb.Execute strDyn, dbFailOnError
        strFmt = Replace("DELETE FROM {0} WHERE Stale = 1", "{0}", tdAny.Name)
        CurrentDb.Execute strFmt, dbFailOnError + dbSeeChanges
    Next tdAny
End Sub
